title: Courgette Cannellini Pea and Mint Soup
ingredients: 400g (14oz) can of cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
large handful of mint leaves, plus extra to serve
method: Spray a large saucepan with oil and fry the onion, courgettes and garlic for 10 minutes over a gentle heat.
Pour in the hot stock, add the cannellini beans and peas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from the heat, add the mint leaves, season with salt and pepper and use a hand blender to blend the soup to a smooth consistency.
Serve with extra mint leaves and grind over some pepper.
notes: Mint is easy to grow at home — keep a pot on the windowsill. Add rocket or watercress for a peppery kick.
